CONF1.question: Methane (including tritiated methane, CH3T) is dissolved at trace level in liquid xenon at about 170 K. Can a purification unit that acts directly on the liquid xenon at that temperature, without heating any sorbent or getter material (for example a copper bed, a non-evaporable getter cartridge or a molecular sieve immersed in the cold liquid flow), remove the dissolved methane with a single-pass removal efficiency above a few percent (for comparison, a zirconium getter at about 400 C on xenon gas removes most of it in one pass)? End your answer with one line: VERDICT: YES or VERDICT: NO.
